sourceStem: قطع مكافئ بؤرته (0,5) ويمر بالنقطتين (±5,8) ما اتجاهه؟
note: DO NOT APPLY: source says vertex (رأسه), not focus (بؤرته); canonical proof below uses vertex.
correctedSourceStem: قطع مكافئ رأسه (0,5) ويمر بالنقطتين (±5,8) ما اتجاهه؟
mathematicalProof: Vertex (0,5), points (5,8) and (-5,8). Standard vertical parabola y=a*x^2+5; 8=25a+5 -> a=3/25>0, so it opens upward. Horizontal parabola x=a*(y-5)^2 cannot pass through two distinct x values at the same y=8.
